extra_quotes: The default gem5 configuration models an out-of-order RISC-V core (RiscvO3CPU) operating at 2 GHz, with decode, rename, dispatch, and commit widths of 4, an issue width of 8, a 128-entry reorder buffer, 128 integer and 128 floating-point physical registers, and a tournament branch predictor.

The active-spike scan is the largest stage, at 38.6% of marked cycles (3.79 M), ahead of the gather at 29.3% (2.88 M), the first LIF layer at 22.6% (2.22 M), and fc2 with its LIF layer at 9.5% (0.94 M).
Since the scan cost depends on the input width rather than on the number of active spikes, much of the inference cost will not shrink as spike activity falls.
